title: Granblue Fantasy: Relink
setting: High-fantasy sky world of floating islands; a crew of skyfarers travels on an airship.
style: Lively fantasy adventure. Natural spoken Thai with warmth and energy; light archaic flavour only for knights, royalty or ancient beings. Keep battle shouts short and punchy.
